summary: The Verge staff list their favorite gadgets and gear that were still discounted after Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2023. Picks span tech tools, kitchen helpers, travel gear, and pet products, each with a personal staff endorsement and, for many, a sale price at Amazon, Best Buy, or Sonos.
one_line: Verge staff share personal favorite tech, kitchen, travel, and pet products that remained discounted after Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2023.
key_facts: Alex Cranz recommends the Tekton Everybit Tech Rescue Kit, a 46-piece screwdriver set on sale for $22 (down from $29, 24% off) at Amazon; she has used it on iPhones, PCs, Steam Decks and Joy-Cons.
Victoria Song uses a 5.5-cup Zojirushi Micom Rice Cooker and Warmer, on sale for $194 (down from $233, 17% off), for porridge, steaming, hard-boiled eggs and baking cakes.
Emma Roth's FoodSaver vacuum sealer is $147 (down from $220, 33% off) and helps keep meat fresh and flatten packages to save freezer space.

Sarah Jeong bought the Anker 321 Power Strip ($15, down from $26, 42% off), which has three AC outlets, two USB-A ports and one USB-C port on a five-foot cable with static prongs, for older buildings with loose sockets.
Brandon Widder recommends the Sonos Roam portable speaker, $134 (down from $180, 26% off) at Best Buy and Sonos; it supports voice commands only when connected to Wi-Fi.

Victoria Song recommends the Epicka universal travel adapter ($20, down from $25), which covers over 150 countries with four plug types and includes a spare fuse, but may not work in Brazil, South Africa or India.
Kaitlin Hatton likes the Anchor Pro under-desk headphone hanger ($12, down from $15, 20% off), which uses 3M adhesive and holds her Razer Kraken headset even as her standing desk moves.
Brandon Widder's MPOWERD string lights are 18 feet long with 100-lumen LEDs, six colors and a 2,000mAh battery, and charge via USB or solar.
Becca Farsace's memory card holder and reader, a birthday gift from Vjeran Pavic, costs $39.95 and has a carabiner hook.
Mitchell Clark praises the ChomChom pet hair remover ($25, down from $32, 22% off) for removing cat hair from his couch and cat tree.
Victoria Song bought a Baboon to the Moon 3L Fannypack in lavender; it fits her wallet, phone and keys and has a quick-release buckle.
Kaitlin Hatton's dog Trudee is entertained by the Pet Fit For Life Plush Wand, a toy on a chewable rope hung from a metal pole.
Sean Hollister uses the iOttie Easy One Touch Qi car charger, which fits almost any phone except an opened Samsung Z Fold.
